claims.claim: Faulty inverter AC available for sale.
claims.evidence: Witness photos show a white portable air conditioner, but do not show inverter status or any fault indicators; no power-on test is shown.

claims.claim: Barely used, bought new last year.
claims.evidence: Witness notes light dust/usage marks, but no readable age/receipt/warranty details are visible in the provided report.

claims.claim: No fault at all, the motor was never opened.
claims.evidence: The report does not include any internal inspection or proof of whether the motor/compressor was opened; no working test is shown.
No receipt/warranty card is shown in the witness observations.

risks.risk: The unit may not be working (seller says faulty inverter; witness provides no power-on/cooling/heating test).
risks.proof: A short video clip of the unit powered on showing temperature set, compressor running (audible/visible vibration), and steady cold air output for several minutes.
risks.if_unproven: Price as non-working/unknown performance portable AC.

risks.risk: Brand/model and capacity (BTU) are not readable, which affects value and suitability.
risks.proof: A close-up, sharp photo of the front label/model plate showing brand, model, and BTU/capacity.
risks.if_unproven: Price at the worst-case for value: treat as lower-capacity/unknown-spec portable AC.

risks.risk: Missing essential accessories/parts (remote, drain hose, window kit/brackets) can make it unusable or reduce usability.
risks.proof: A full photo inventory laid out on the floor: remote, drain hose, window kit/brackets, manual, and any power cable/fittings.

risks.risk: Refrigerant leak or need for recharge (common failure for ACs; not verifiable from exterior photos).
risks.proof: A technician test report or a clip showing stable cooling performance plus any evidence of pressure/temperature readings (or leak test result).
risks.if_unproven: Price as potential refrigerant issue (recharge/repair risk).

risks.risk: Filter/evaporator condition (mold/dust buildup) affecting hygiene and performance.
risks.proof: A photo/clip of the filter removed and the evaporator coil condition (clean vs dusty/moldy).

risks.risk: Electrical condition (plug/cable/fuse/board health) not shown; could be unsafe or intermittent.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the plug and cable condition plus a power-on test showing no tripping and stable operation.
risks.if_unproven: Price as electrical/board unknown (higher repair risk).

proof_requests: Close-up photo of the brand/model plate showing exact model and BTU/capacity.
Video of the unit running: power on, compressor start, airflow, and cooling performance for at least 5–10 minutes.
Photos of included accessories: remote, drain hose, window kit/brackets, manual, and any warranty/receipt documents.
Photo/clip of the filter removed and evaporator coil condition.
If possible, technician confirmation of inverter/compressor health and refrigerant status (leak test or recharge history).
response.reason: The witness confirms it is a portable air conditioner, but key value drivers (exact model/BTU, working status, accessories, and refrigerant/electrical health) are not verifiable from the report. Because the seller’s statements conflict (faulty vs no fault) and no power-on evidence is provided, proof is needed before a reliable price.
